design_philosophy: Premium, minimal, and deeply atmospheric. A mix of classic chess heritage with modern glowing neon accents to signify new rules. The interface should feel like an elite club mixed with an esports command center.

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid (Dense). Mode selectors should be visually distinct bento boxes.

buttons.primary: bg-yellow-500 text-black font-bold rounded-full px-6 py-3 flex-row justify-center items-center active:opacity-80
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-zinc-800 text-white rounded-full px-6 py-3 flex-row justify-center items-center active:bg-zinc-900
buttons.icon: p-3 rounded-full bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 active:bg-zinc-800

cards.mode_card: bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl p-5 relative overflow-hidden
cards.stat_card: bg-zinc-900/50 border border-zinc-800/50 rounded-xl p-4 flex-col items-center justify-center

modals.rule_explanation: bg-zinc-950/90 border border-zinc-800 rounded-3xl p-6 absolute bottom-0 w-full

backgrounds.description: Abstract dark background with wisps of smoke
Dark blue fabric with soft light reflections

game_thumbnails.description: Moody chess set with dramatic lighting
A 3D chessboard showcasing intricate metal and wooden pieces

motion_and_interactions.piece_drag: Scale slightly (1.1) and add a drop-shadow while dragging.
motion_and_interactions.move_highlight: Fade in yellow/cyan highlight pulse on valid squares.
motion_and_interactions.rule_reveal: Slide up modal from bottom with a spring damping effect.
motion_and_interactions.check_alert: Red screen flash border for 300ms, haptic feedback trigger.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on zinc-900 passes APCA contrast.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all icon buttons and chessboard squares on mobile.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Include `data-testid` on all interactive UI elements (buttons, inputs, chessboard squares, mode cards).
Build standard React Native `.js` files with NativeWind tailwind classes, avoiding `.tsx` strictly.
Implement the 'Learn This Rule' modal with React Native Modal or Reanimated bottom sheet using glassmorphism.
Chess pieces should be rendered using high-quality SVG (react-native-svg) with clear contours, DO NOT use standard emojis.
The board squares must alternate correctly and respond cleanly to touch/press events for piece selection and movement.
For the daily challenge streak, use the 'classic' accent color (#EAB308) to display a fiery/glowing streak counter.
